name: Unique Characteristics of the Citadel’s Dungeons
description: Undying Spirits.When an undead in the citadel falls, the spirit possessing it is freed. In 1d10 minutes, it possesses the nearest remains, retaining its memories and intent. The dungeon harbors about forty spirits, making any long stay here a living nightmare. Corpse Preservation.An ancient enchantment placed by the citadel’s former wizard inhabitants prevents corpses in the dungeon from decaying. Corpse Abundance.The dungeon is littered with remains of humanoid soldiers, experiments executed by the wizards when they abandoned the citadel, and fallen adventurers who died trying to challenge the dungeons’ depths.
